thread:
ina: Quick sync: PM wants a compact launch slate for private deploy networking that operations can actually support. We need one-line ship criteria and clear exceptions.

peter: Proposal: ship `isolation` installer profile (VPC-only, no relay), `preserve-egress` alpha (NAT pinning), and `bgp-preview` (handshake-only). GA gated on cloud adapters + KV-checksum.

mira: One-line criteria examples: "Alpha: 2 pilots validated 48h; Dry-run upgrade succeeds; Docs + rollback playbook present." Keep it explicit.

field-julian: Field wants a standard maintenance SLA template we can give customers: default maintenance window, opt-in longer windows, and rollback RT (rebind target <5m).

ina: Good. Also add a "known limitations" snippet: list clouds where IP reclaim is common, and note air-gapped customers need presigned bundles and manual handshake.

peter: Tech note: operator needs a small persistent mapping store and a `--upgrade-profile` flag (fast|safe). Safe uses KV checksum + staged cutover. Safe is required if preserve-egress=true.

mira: QA matrix: cold restart, rolling upgrade, node replacement, simulated IP reclaim, streaming-session continuity. Each test should be runnable in e2e harness.

deploy-bot: Canary: build 4367890155 deployed to canary cluster. Logs: http://ci.internal/4367890155

field-julian: I'll collect 3 pilot candidates and run the maintenance SLA template by Friday. We should include a short email template for pilot invites.

ina: Action items: peter -> spike mapping store + CLI flags; mira -> draft QA matrix + playbook; julian -> pilot list+comm; I'll update PRD with the one-line criteria.

peter: I'll also draft a small console widget mock for migration state and a manual rollback button.

mira: Will add telemetry keys: egress_rebind_success, rebind_latency_ms, upgrade_dryrun_ok.

ina: Thanks team 44d closing loop.
